name: book
title: 3D Book Display
description: A row of book-shaped cards with gradient covers, a pale page edge and a title block. Pointing at one rotates it about thirty degrees so its spine comes into view.
use: A blog, library or bookstore wants cover art shown as physical objects rather than flat thumbnails.
avoid: Its dark stage and white cover text assume a dark page; on a light background the shadow and spine lose contrast.
a11y: The tilt is hover-only, so keyboard and touch users never see the spine; cover text is plain but otherwise unlabelled. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three rectangular book covers stand upright on a black stage, in indigo, deep rose and green. Each has a solid gradient cover, a light page-edge stripe on the right, a small tag, a bold title and tiny body copy at the lower left.
behaves: At rest a cover faces straight ahead. Hovering tips it back about thirty degrees to reveal the white spine and page edge, easing slowly into place; one copy is pinned at that angle.
customise: Book takes color, size, radius, shadowSize, duration and isStatic; cover text comes from the child BookHeader, BookTitle and BookDescription.
weight: light: Three DOM boxes and a single CSS transform transition; nothing runs at rest.
demo: Fiction / The Lost City, Design / UI Patterns, and Notes with short blurbs.
issues: The small description type on each cover is hard to read at this size.
polishWhy: Convincing book form with a clean tilt; the smallest cover's copy is hard to read.
usage:
"use client"; import { Book, BookDescription, BookHeader, BookTitle } from "@/components/ui/book"; export default function BookDemo() { return (
